calls.text:
I'm E.D.I.T.H. Just text me what you need.

If I'm busy, I read new messages before I answer. Start one with /btw to run it in a parallel lane straight away (up to 2).

/menu – quick action buttons
/brief /mail /today /servers /changes – quick actions
/reminders – upcoming reminders (say "remind me…" to add one)
/btw <task> – run in parallel while I'm busy
/queue <task> – wait for the current task instead of running in parallel
/new – start a fresh conversation
/sessions – switch back to an earlier conversation
/resume <n|name> – switch by number or name
/name <title> – name the current conversation
/compact [instructions] – compact the conversation (optional: what to keep)
/stop – stop all running tasks
/status – what I'm doing right now
/restart – restart the bridge (after updates)
/help – this message
